meta.name: env
meta.description:
Install and manage software packages, language runtimes, and CLI tools instantly.
Zero barrier — install x-cmd and get any tool in seconds. No sudo required.
Use for "install", "package", "python", "node", "jq", "runtime", "tool".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键安装和管理各类软件包与运行时
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速安装命令行工具或语言运行时
copy.tagline_en: Install and manage software packages and runtimes instantly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly install CLI tools or language runtimes

howto.what: 安装和管理软件包、语言运行时及命令行工具，无需管理员权限，不污染系统。
howto.when: 当你提到“安装”、“包”、“python”、“node”、“jq”、“运行时”、“工具”等关键词，或要求安装软件时触发。

say.note: 会安装指定版本的 Python。

say.text: 临时试用 jq 处理 JSON
say.note: 使用 x env try 临时运行，不永久安装。
执行 x env clean 移除未使用的包。

howto.what_en: Install and manage software packages, language runtimes, and CLI tools instantly without sudo or system pollution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "install", "package", "python", "node", "jq", "runtime", "tool", or ask to install software.

say_en.text: Try jq temporarily to process JSON.
say_en.note: Uses x env try for temporary use without permanent install.
Runs x env clean to remove unused packages.
